entries.note: Drive the real pinned terminal parser through attached/output messages with contiguous sequences. Assertions cover signed fractional wheel behavior, stable viewed text under new output, primary/alternate isolation, CSI 3 J history clearing, line/byte caps and fresh-snapshot replacement. The old FLIPPED assertion was corrected after the owner report and pinned Cocoa source confirmed inversion is already in the deltas; the corrected test failed before the fix. Both-axis scrollbar endpoints use a million-unit range to exercise wide multiplication and out-of-track drag/release. Native desktop tests separately verify actual pointer actions, PTYs, rendered colors, focus routing, resize and retained-process restart.
